subject: SIG: Subprocessor registry for EU data scoping
messages:
From: Petra Schmidt <petra.schmidt@astratech.de>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:17:00 +0200
Subject: SIG: Request for subprocessor registry (EU data scope)

Hi Ava,

I'm the security assessor for AstraTech GmbH. As part of our SIG review and EU data residency assessment we need a current subprocessor registry scoped to any vendors that process or route EU personal data (including telemetry, error tracking, support, analytics, and cloud regions). Specifically we need: 

- List of subprocessors with role (cloud, telemetry, support, analytics, monitoring) and country of processing
- Whether each subprocessor has access to customer data in plaintext or only aggregated/telemetry hashes
- Any EU-specific contracts or SCCs in place, and the date of last legal review
- Data flow diagram showing ingress/egress points for EU traffic

Can you provide the registry and a simple dataflow PDF by EOD 2027-04-27? We're running a tight procurement timeline.

If there are planned changes (e.g., new telemetry vendor rollouts), please call them out. We may follow up with targeted evidence requests (SCCs, SOC 2 cover pages, KMS attestations).

Thanks,

Petra Schmidt
Senior Security Analyst
AstraTech GmbH
petra.schmidt@astratech.de
+49 30 1234 5678

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Petra Schmidt <petra.schmidt@astratech.de>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for subprocessor registry (EU data scope)

Hi Petra — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to provide the requested registry and a focused EU dataflow diagram. Quick notes / plan: 

- We'll deliver a pre-populated subprocessor census (attached) with the fields you listed.
- Dev (cc'd) will validate telemetry vendor access levels and confirm whether any vendors process plaintext customer data.
- Marissa (cc'd) will check legal for SCC status and attach the last review dates where available.

Can you confirm the list of products in scope for AstraTech (e.g., inference API, telemetry only, embeddings)? That will help us mark which subprocessors are in-scope vs. out-of-scope. If you prefer, we can provide a separate sheet per product.

Target: initial registry + dataflow PDF by 2027-04-27 EOD. If you need docs sooner for procurement, let us know and we'll prioritize the cloud/vendor list first.

Attachments: subprocessor-census-template.csv (blank), eu-dataflow-diagram.pdf (draft)

Best,

Ava Chen
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Petra Schmidt <petra.schmidt@astratech.de>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for subprocessor registry (EU data scope)

Petra / Ava — quick inventory to seed the census (high level). I'll flag access type in the CSV: plaintext, encrypted-at-rest-only, telemetry-only (no PII):

- Cloud: AWS (eu-west-1) — compute + object storage (may store customer model artifacts and logs) — access: encrypted at rest; logs may contain minimal customer identifiers (request ids).
- Edge cache provider: FastEdge CDN (eu-central) — caches static payloads, telemetry headers only.
- Telemetry / observability: FlareOps (US-based, EU-region collection) — telemetry-only; stores traces and error payloads; sensitive PII redaction applied at ingest.
- Support / ticketing: SupportFlow (US) — support engineers access anonymized request snapshots; PII access requires case-level approval.
- Embeddings similarity index: VectorStoreX (managed EU cluster) — customer vectors stored; access restricted to service account.
- Monitoring alerts: PagerTeam (global) — alert metadata; no customer content.

Planned changes: evaluating a replacement for FlareOps in Q3 for EU-only vendor — noted in the "notes" column of the CSV.

I'll attach a quick CSV with these rows filled and mark whether SCCs exist.

Dev
Principal Platform Engineer, Runtime
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Petra Schmidt <petra.schmidt@astratech.de>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for subprocessor registry (EU data scope)

Thanks Ava / Dev — this is helpful and on the right level. A few clarifications from our procurement team: 

- For anything marked "telemetry-only" we still need confirmation of redaction at ingest (screenshots or a short description of the redaction step).
- For cloud storage that can contain customer artifacts (AWS), please include the KMS key policy owner and whether those keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed.
- For SupportFlow, we need the escalation process for approving access to PII (who signs off, typical SLA to redact/erase).

If you can add those three items to the CSV and include any SOC 2 cover page or recent audit report links where available, we can finalize the SIG section. We'll accept a redacted SOC 2 cover page if full report is restricted.

We plan to close the procurement checklist by 2027-04-30; if you can get these items by 2027-04-28 EOD it'll keep us on schedule.

Regards,

Petra
Senior Security Analyst, AstraTech GmbH
